key_highlights: ASX suffers fourth consecutive losing week as bond yields climb, pressuring equities across sectors
RBA signals continued hiking despite sharp unemployment rise, creating an 'interest rate pincer' for households
AUD experiences a 'trapdoor' move, weakening materially against USD
Australian house prices over halfway to largest 40-year correction, with Victoria hardest hit
Gold exploration sector active: Zenith, Aurum, Kuniko report strong assay results; small-cap cap raises total $2.7B
Star's Sydney casino licence remains suspended, weighing on gaming/entertainment names
Xi-Trump meeting signals shifting China-US dynamics with implications for iron ore and commodity demand
Data centre boom straining energy supply, creating headwinds for energy sector

sectors.trend: Gold exploration names (Zenith, Aurum, Kuniko) showing strong assay results; small-cap cap raises at $2.7B indicate capital hunger. Xi-Trump meeting may shift iron ore demand outlook. Anax Metals, Many Peaks, MinRex among weekly big hits.
sectors.implications: Gold juniors attract speculative flows amid AUD weakness and geopolitical uncertainty. Major miners (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX) face mixed signals from China-US dynamics. Small-cap dilution risk elevated.

sectors.trend: RBA hawkish stance despite unemployment surge pressures NIMs but raises credit risk. Renters' financial stress (>50% struggling) signals rising NPL risk. Interest rate pincer squeezes household balance sheets.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin pressure from rate volatility. Credit losses may rise as unemployment climbs. Defensive dividend appeal intact but growth outlook muted.

sectors.trend: House prices over halfway to largest 40-year correction. CBD commercial tower listed at $40m (lending library). Dusty Martin selling $20m portfolio at haircut. Renters' stress supports residential demand but caps pricing.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX, SPG.AX) face valuation pressure from falling asset values. Residential REITs may see occupancy support but yield compression. Commercial property under stress.

sectors.trend: Data centre boom creating energy demand surge but supply constraints ('energy bust'). Bird flu delays caged egg rules in Victoria affecting agribusiness. Bathla site funding collapse signals infrastructure risk.
sectors.implications: Energy names (SME.AX, WES.AX, AGL.AX) benefit from structural demand but face capex pressure. Utilities offer defensive yield in volatile environment.

sectors.trend: Star's Sydney casino licence suspended, hitting gaming revenue. Card surcharge phase-out reshaping retail payments. Consumer spending under pressure from rate pincer and housing correction.
sectors.implications: Star Entertainment (STAR.AX) faces prolonged revenue hit. WES.AX, WOW.AX, CSG.AX face soft consumer demand. Payments sector (IPG.AX) benefits from surcharge changes.

sectors.trend: AI infrastructure trade active globally (Nvidia, AMD, Lumentum). Medicare breach prompts AI safety legislation push. CSL.AX remains defensive anchor. Data centre energy demand supports tech infrastructure.
sectors.implications: ASX tech exposure limited but CSL.AX, SXW.AX benefit from healthcare demand. AI safety regulation could create compliance costs. Global AI chip rally offers indirect sentiment support.

key_themes: RBA hawkish pivot vs rising unemployment creates policy dilemma
AUD trapdoor weakens commodity exporters' local revenue but supports gold
Housing correction accelerates, largest in 40 years, with Victoria as epicentre
Small-cap mining capital raises at record $2.7B signal speculative froth
Geopolitical shift (Xi-Trump) reshaping China demand for Australian commodities
Energy supply-demand imbalance from data centre boom
Immigration policy debate affecting labour supply and housing demand

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA continued hiking amid rising unemployment
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight defensive sectors (healthcare, utilities); reduce leverage; monitor RBA statement for dovish pivot signals
Hedge FX exposure; favour export-oriented miners (BHP.AX, RIO.AX) whose USD revenue benefits from weak AUD
Reduce REIT and construction exposure; monitor bank NPL data; favour cash-rich balance sheets
Avoid sub-$50m cap names with repeated raises; focus on proven producers over explorers

risk_assessment.risk_factor: China-US geopolitical shift impacting iron ore demand
risk_assessment.mitigation: Diversify commodity exposure; monitor iron ore pricing and China stimulus signals

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Energy supply constraints from data centre demand
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour integrated energy producers with long-term offtake contracts; monitor AEMO capacity warnings

opportunities.rationale: AUD weakness, geopolitical uncertainty, and strong assay results (Zenith 6/6 hits, Aurum 155g/t) support gold pricing; ASX gold names benefit from dual AUD/commodity tailwind

opportunities.recommendation: Add defensive healthcare and utilities exposure
opportunities.rationale: Fourth straight ASX losing week and rate pincer favour low-beta, dividend-paying names; CSL and WES offer resilience

opportunities.recommendation: Selective exposure to major iron ore producers on AUD weakness
opportunities.rationale: AUD trapdoor boosts local-currency earnings for USD-revenue miners; Xi-Trump meeting may stabilise China demand

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce REIT and residential property exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: 40-year house price correction underway; CBD commercial listings at fire-sale prices; renter stress signals demand ceiling

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid small-cap mining cap raises and speculative explorers
defensive_moves.rationale: $2.7B cap raise torrent signals dilution risk; many names lack proven reserves; market in risk-off mode

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge equity portfolio with AUD put options or bond allocation
defensive_moves.rationale: Bond yields climbing and AUD in freefall; fourth losing week suggests trend continuation risk

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to extend weakness in 1-3 month window. RBA hawkish bias, rising unemployment, and AUD depreciation create a negative feedback loop. Bond yield climb pressures equity valuations. Fourth losing week may trigger stop-loss cascades. Gold and major miners relative outperformance expected.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautiously constructive if RBA pivots dovish as unemployment peaks. Housing correction may stabilise by mid-2027. Structural energy demand from data centres supports utilities. China-US resolution could lift commodity sentiment. Immigration policy shifts may ease housing pressure.
